description: Medicare-subsidised mental health-specific services is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW). An annual summary report on Medicare-subsidised mental health services, prepared by the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare (AIHW). The data includes number of persons who accessed Medicare-subsidised mental health-specific services and the number of services provided by type of service (e.g., GP, psychiatrist, psychologist). The data is available at different geographic levels, including state, Remoteness Area, Primary Health Network (PHN), and SA3. Coverage is Australia, 2007 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
